name: Huron County, Ohio (United States)
description: Swallowtail flag of a horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the county seal in green and yellow reading AGRICULTURE INDUSTRY COMMERCE and HURON COUNTY 1809.
history: Huron County is a county located in Ohio. The flag was adopted on 16 July 2002 (a composite of four winning entries in a 2002 residents' contest, adopted by the Board of Commissioners on 16 July 2002 and unveiled on 10 September 2002 for the Ohio bicentennial, according to Flags of the World).
